svg.title: What each stage of a literature review is worth writing down
svg.desc: A narrowing funnel of four stages. About four hundred papers are found, and each earns one line: a title and where it came from. About a hundred and twenty are screened, and each earns a verdict and a reason — including the rejections. About forty are read properly, and each earns a full seven-part note. About fifteen are cited, and each earns the claim, the page number and the citation key written back into the note.
svg.text: A title and where it came from. One line.
A verdict and the reason — rejections too.
The claim, the page, the citation key.
Writing a full note on everything at the top is how a literature review stalls in week six.
